description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveEntitlementDao component within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It contains multiple test methods that validate the functionality of retrieving, saving, updating, deleting, and querying leave entitlement data, including interactions with associated entities such as Employee, LeaveType, and LeaveEntitlement. It also covers complex scenarios like entitlement calculations and report generation.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of the LeaveEntitlementDao, covering CRUD operations, complex queries, and report generation related to leave entitlements in OrangeHRM.
